meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在处理 BIDS 神经科学数据集时，会按规范组织目录、用 PyBIDS 查询文件、运行 bids-validator 查合规、把 DICOM 转成 BIDS、写 JSON sidecar，并生成 derivatives。
howto.when: 当你要整理或查询 BIDS 数据集、校验它是否符合规范，或把 DICOM 转成 BIDS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 BIDS 数据集跑一遍 bids-validator，看哪里不合规
say.note: 会列出校验发现的错误和警告

howto.what_en: When you work with BIDS neuroscience datasets, it organizes data into the standard layout, queries files with PyBIDS, runs bids-validator for compliance, converts DICOM to BIDS, writes JSON sidecars, and creates derivatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you organize or query a BIDS dataset, validate it against the specification, or convert DICOM data to BIDS.

say_en.text: Run bids-validator on this BIDS dataset and show what's non-compliant
Use PyBIDS to find sub-01's rest task bold file
Convert this DICOM folder to BIDS with HeuDiConv
